title: What Happens When You Order a Replacement Card
summary: Explains what happens after ordering a replacement card: the current card is cancelled (cannot be used for new purchases) and a new card is issued with a different card number and CVV. Your account number stays the same so recurring payments continue; you must update saved merchant card details and, if fraud-related, review recent transactions in the Rho-Bank app/website and report unauthorized charges. You receive emails when the replacement order is placed and when it ships, and should follow any activation instructions.
faqs: After I order a replacement card, can I still use my old card?
Will my account number change or stay the same for recurring payments?
What information changes on the replacement card (card number and CVV)?
Do I need to update my saved payment details with merchants, and what should I do?
If the replacement is for suspected fraud, what steps should I take?
What notifications will I receive for the replacement card order and shipment?
